---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the DataWeave Playground
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it.
E.g. "I always have to manually convert CSV and it's tedious because..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case Example
Provide a concrete example of how this feature would be used.

**Example Script:**
```
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---

```

## Priority
How important is this to your workflow?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Blocking my use of the playground

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
